name: IMC Exploration Group Public Limited Company
summary: IMC Exploration Group Public Limited Company explores for gold, zinc, silver, and other minerals primarily in the Republic of Ireland. The company's primary projects include Avoca, Co. Wicklow; the north Wexford gold project; and zinc project located near to the Kilbricken deposit in Tulla, Co. Clare. IMC Exploration Group Public Limited Company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Dublin, the Republic of Ireland.
